name: agience-server-astra
description: Captures and prepares incoming information through ingestion, validation, normalization, indexing, hygiene, and telemetry collection.

tools.name: ingest_file
tools.description: Ingest a file URL or raw text into a workspace as a card

tools.name: document_text_extract
tools.description: Extract text from a PDF artifact and create a derived text artifact

tools.name: process_uploaded_content
tools.description: Process uploaded text content � extract text and create derived artifacts for search and agent use

tools.name: validate_input
tools.description: Validate incoming data against a schema or content rules

tools.name: normalize_artifact
tools.description: Normalize card content � standardize fields, clean formatting, resolve encodings

tools.name: apply_metadata
tools.description: Merge caller-supplied metadata into an artifact's context.metadata field, then re-index so the fields become searchable. Deterministic merge; no model involved

tools.name: ingest_pipeline
tools.description: Run the document ingestion pipeline on a PDF artifact: deduplication check → text extraction

tools.name: deduplicate
tools.description: Check for duplicate content by SHA-256 hash. Stamps content_hash on the artifact context and searches the workspace for prior ingestions of the same file

tools.name: classify_content
tools.description: Raises. No-models rule: this platform runs no trained classifier

tools.name: connect_source
tools.description: Register an external connector (Drive folder, inbox, Slack channel)

tools.name: sync_source
tools.description: Pull latest content from a registered connector into the workspace

tools.name: index_artifact
tools.description: Force re-index of a card into the search layer

tools.name: ingest_text
tools.description: Extract text from an uploaded artifact, optionally chunk it, and create derived workspace artifacts (ingest.parsed_text and ingest.chunk) that are automatically indexed by the search pipeline

tools.name: transcribe
tools.description: Finalize a completed stream session card into a transcript card

tools.name: collect_telemetry
tools.description: Collect and record system activity telemetry as workspace cards

tools.name: rotate_stream_key
tools.description: Generate or rotate the RTMP stream key for a stream source artifact

MANTLE_URI.description: Base URI of the Mantle backend

MCP_HOST.description: Bind host for the MCP server

MCP_PORT.description: HTTP port for the MCP server

STREAM_INGEST_URL.description: Public RTMP ingest URL for OBS clients (e.g. rtmp://rtmp.example.com/live)

_env_note: AGIENCE_API_URI and AGIENCE_API_KEY were declared required here and are read NOWHERE in server.py (verified 2026-07-31). A deployer honouring this manifest set two dead variables and omitted MANTLE_URI, which then silently defaulted to localhost:8081. This note lives at TOP LEVEL, not inside config.env — a consumer iterating env would otherwise see a variable named '_removed'.
_tools_note: Generated from the @mcp.tool registrations in server.py on 2026-07-31. It previously advertised tools that do not exist and omitted tools that do; a client reads this array to discover the surface.
